verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents connectors that auto-sync external data sources (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) via real-time webhooks, and user profiles that auto-update in the background from interactions without manual search — both are forms of autonomous background processing. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, scheduled tasks, or agent-triggered background jobs beyond data sync and profile maintenance. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger configuration UI, evidence of arbitrary background 'automations' beyond connector sync and profile updates, and independent confirmation these run reliably unattended.
